page: Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. This virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 48 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

A primary feature of the L48as_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, offering 11,519 GB of local storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and operates without a dedicated GPU.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the L48as_v5 offers high resource density by combining a large memory footprint with massive local storage capacity on a single dedicated-core instance. This configuration is designed for data-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large relational databases, NoSQL databases, big data analytics, and memory-intensive transactional applications that require low-latency access to large local datasets.
